dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And how would you differentiate them?

dialogues.speaker: Herbier
dialogues.text: Well, we'd need to analyze each case in detail, but I've always had a personal "prescription."

dialogues.speaker: Herbier
dialogues.text: If Lady Furina comes personally and looks excited, then there will be something incredible about the case, even if it isn't an important one.

dialogues.speaker: Herbier
dialogues.text: ...Even if there's nothing special about the case, Lady Furina can create drama herself.

dialogues.speaker: Herbier
dialogues.text: And if the Chief Justice personally presides over the trial, it'll most likely be worth paying attention to. Certainly more newsworthy, at any rate.

dialogues.speaker: Herbier
dialogues.text: But such cases aren't very easy to report on. In fact, some of them involve information blackouts.

dialogues.speaker: Herbier
dialogues.text: But now... it seems like only half the "prescription" is applicable.
